name: Receipt print
oneLiner: a thermal receipt feeds up out of a real printer's slot in short bursts on twos, line items printing as they come out, the lifted paper curling toward the lens, then the total is thumped with a brand-colour rubber stamp
say: when the speaker adds something up ('here is what it actually costs', 'the whole stack is'): the items print as they list them and the stamp lands on the total
